agent_orientation: The machine is a version space, not a mind. It says what it can name and refuses by name what it cannot. This round it learned to name a row -- a region of one observation -- and to prove when it cannot (no element shows the identifier; the record holds no such control; the record is one page-turn away). It holds no memory, reads no reward, and claims no sentence about itself beyond what was measured.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only: naming a region of an observation is the cheapest currently available prerequisite to any later work that must say 'that one'. No obligation discharge, benchmark gain, capability credit or independent verification is claimed.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: Six email pages that three rounds of refusal had called 'state outside the observation' now resolve from the instruction alone: open the named record, write the quoted text, press the control the sentence names -- with the page's reward read only afterwards.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Naming the region of an observation that a word picks out, and proving by name when it cannot: more than one record matches, the record holds no such control, no element shows the identifier, or the record is reachable but not present.
